viewed: Every catalogued still was opened, and every APNG was opened at its first frame, on 2026-11-10. lookingAt is the gaze in that picture (left/right = the viewer's screen left/right). facing is the body direction when it differs from a straight front stance. bodyFacing is the body direction and must equal facing. The feet are checked separately in feetFacing (see feetAudit), because a body can turn while the feet still point the other way.
feetAudit: feetFacing is the direction the toes point (left/right = the viewer's screen left/right; front = straight at the viewer or splayed). Every full-body picture was opened and its feet checked by eye on 2026-11-11 (t228). Rules, enforced by viewer/tests/cast-images.test.js and check_course.py: (1) the feet never point away from the face: if facing, or else lookingAt, is left or right, feetFacing is that side or front; (2) a side-facing walking picture has feetFacing equal to facing; (3) feetMeasured (written by viewer/tools/measure_cast_bboxes.py from the pixels) must agree with feetFacing whenever its offset is clear (|offset| >= 0.15), except for sitting pictures, where chair legs confuse the measurement. The stage also avoids a picture whose feet would point away from the person it looks at, mirroring it when allowed.

height.courseAge: Grade 1 / story year 0 (the current year-01 art).
height.twins: Bora and Sreyneang have baselineAge 6 in process/cast/cast.json. Heights use WHO Child Growth Standards (2006/2007) height-for-age medians at 6.0 years: 116 cm (boys), 115 cm (girls). Marked estimated: true because the baseline is "about 6" at official entrance, not a birthday.
height.others: Except Bopha (a classmate, drawn at the twins' height), no baseline age is recorded for anyone else. Height is estimated from the year-01 relative_scale in exports/cast-year-01/tools/chars.json (also in manifest.json), anchored to Bora: heightCm = round(116 × scale / 0.7).
